extracted.name: Cream of Chicken Breasts
extracted.description: This baked chicken with cream of chicken soup recipe is made with boneless breasts smothered in creamy chicken soup and baked until tender and juicy.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Place chicken in a 9x13-inch baking dish; season with poultry seasoning.
Mix together condensed soup and milk in a bowl. Pour soup mixture evenly over chicken.

Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, 40 to 50 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
